messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "apply the device to a flat, clean, hairless area of the abdomen below the rib cage and above the belt line"
set: ["apply the device to a flat, clean, hairless area of the abdomen below the rib cage and above the belt line", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "do not reuse the device", "do not apply lotions or creams to the area where it is placed", "apply the skin patch to your hip area 2 hours before an effect is needed", "check the instructions on the label", "throw the bag in the trash", "press the device firmly against your skin", "child's dose is based on the age and weight of the child", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "this is the reason for the recommendation", "if you lift the device away before the window is completely yellow, you may not get the full dose", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby", "measure a dose with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon)", "do not transfer the insulin from the pen into a syringe", "take in either the morning or the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
